reviewFindings: Utility worker input is bounded and validated before process dispatch; raw decoded responses require matching dimensions and exact RGBA byte length.

Compressed responses validate dimensions, declared output length and compressed payload bound. The main process restores into an exact-size buffer using 1 MiB inflate chunks, rejects excess/short output, and destroys an active inflater on cancellation.
Fake regressions cover cancellation after inflate starts, late events after cancellation, mismatched raw dimensions and short/long raw pixel buffers.
The five-sample measurement is scoped to one deterministic synthetic 16 MP PNG and reports utility-process PeakWorkingSet64; it does not establish an all-input or full-app memory guarantee.
